_note: Numbers of the interface, not the sim (design 14 §3; 02 §4). Distances in CSS px, times in ms.

because._note: The Because system (design 14 §4): sparkMs how long the sparkle lingers at the place, tapWorld how near a finger must land (world px), cardMs how long the card is up in all, cardHoldMs how long it is solid before it starts fading, cardGap how far it floats from the spot (CSS px; its size is measured, never assumed), whyMs how long a cause icon rides over a head.

trayCol._note: Tray item columns: at least min px wide, sized so part of the next column always shows (peek of a column), the sign that the tray scrolls.
